messages:
Priya (sre-oncall): noticing a sharp spike in 502/504 for hosted API since deploy started ~13m ago. canary traffic looks impacted. rolling numbers: 502s went from ~0.3% to 6.8% :rotating_light:
Liam (eng-runtime): ack. which rollout id? any config flags flipped during canary?
Priya (sre-oncall): rollout r-2026-03-17-primer. config toggle `route.prefetch_enabled=true` + new routing table for canary variant.
Eleni (support): multiple customers reporting timeouts and 502s, CS tickets #8792 #8801. some include curl reproducer with Authorization header.
Marco (oncall): I pulled live gateway logs: `upstream read timeout from model-proxy-02` and `502 UpstreamIdleTimeout` across canary pool nodes. stack traces show model-proxy hitting `kv-cache` miss path more frequently.
Liam (eng-runtime): that kv-cache path change was part of the canary binary. possible regression with cache miss backpressure. can we isolate traffic to non-canary?
Priya (sre-oncall): temporarily toggled traffic weight to 0% for canary via rollout-controller. seeing 502s drop to baseline within 90s. looks like canary is the cause.
Eleni (support): customers need ETA. conveying rollback happened, but they want cause. prepping repro steps.
Liam (eng-runtime): new binary had a change to `batching.max_inflight` default (2->6) which combined with `prefetch_enabled` can blow up mem usage and trigger upstream stalls. I recommend rolling the canary back and doing a controlled test.
Taylor (billing): FYI some requests from high-volume customers retried -> duplicate billing events. holding off billing reconciliation until we confirm no double-charges.
Priya (sre-oncall): rollback fully completed at ts 2487654321+166. system metrics: request latency and 5xx returned to normal. collecting artifacts for postmortem.
Marco (oncall): saved model-proxy logs + kernel traces to /var/logs/incidents/2487654321/ ; snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] model-proxy-02 ERROR upstream read timeout after 120s; inflight=58; mem=82%
[2026-03-17T09:12:04Z] gateway WARN 502 Generated; route=api.v1.generate; canary=true; shard=gpux-7
```
Liam (eng-runtime): repro steps for dev env:
1) deploy canary build r-2026-03-17-primer to staging
2) set header `X-Canary: true` and enable `prefetch_enabled=true`
3) run stress script: `ab -n 5000 -c 50 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Expect: increased read timeouts and 502s when batching and prefetch interact.
Eleni (support): I'll send a templated update to impacted customers: rolled back canary, investigating root cause, will follow up with timeline and mitigations. :white_check_mark:
Priya (sre-oncall): next actions: 1) full postmortem + RCA (assign Liam/Marco), 2) add automated canary smoke check for kv-cache/backpressure, 3) coordinate billing reconciliation with Taylor. tagging @eng-runtime and @billing for follow-up.
SupportBot: Incident 2487654321 closed (status: mitigated)
Priya (sre-oncall): closing thread, will drop link to postmortem when ready.
